## OTITIS EXTERNA
## Acute Localized Disease
Often due to furunculosis and usually associated with Staphylococcus aureus.
Treat mild cases with moist local heat. For cases with cellulitis or deep
invasion, incision and drainage as well as systemic antibiotics may be needed.
Refer to the [Furuncles and Carbuncles](orzc-gmenu-furuncles-and-carbuncles) page for antibiotic recommendations.
Furuncles and Carbuncles

## Acute diffuse and chronic otitis externa
Most commonly associated with Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Staphylococcus aureus and
Staphylococcus epidermidis. Irrigate to remove cerumen, desquamated skin and
purulent material which can improve effectiveness of topical antibiotics. Avoid
products that contain neomycin if the tympanic membrane is perforated.
## Preferred treatment if tympanic membrane is intact
[Neomycin-polymyxin-hydrocortisone ear drops 4 drops in affected ear(s) QID](psjzid-neomycin-polymixin-hc-otic-4-drps-qid)
for 7 days ($) [M]
## Alternative if tympanic membrane is perforated or allergy to preferred treatmen
[Ciprofloxacin-Dexamethasone otic 4 drops in affected ear(s) BID for 7 days ($)](psjzid-ciprofloxacin-dexamethasone-otic-4-drps-bid)
[M]
## _______________________________________________________________________________
## Complicated Cases
For cases resistant to topical therapy alone, patients with poorly controlled
diabetes mellitus, immunocompromised patients, cases where infection has spread
beyond ear canal and in those where topical therapy cannot be delivered
effectively. Culture secretions to guide therapy.
In addition to topical therapy above
[< ADD > ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h for 7 days ($) [R,DI]](psjzid-ciprofl-500mg-po-q12h)

## Acute diffuse and chronic otitis externa
Most commonly associated with Pseudomonas aerogenosa and Staphylococcus
aureus/epidermidis. Irrigate to remove cerumen, desquamated skin and purulent
material which can improve effectiveness of topical antibiotics. Avoid products
that contain neomycin if the tympanic membrane is perforated.
Treat for 7 to 10 days
## Preferred treatment if tympanic membrane is intact
Neomycin-polymixin-hydrocortisone ear drops 4 drops in affected ear(s) QID
## Alternative if tympanic membrane is perforated or allergy to preferred treatmen
Ciprofloxacin-Dexamethasone otic 4 drops in affected ear(s) BID ($) [M]
## Complicated Cases
For cases resistant to topical therapy alone, diabetic patients,
immunocompromised patients, cases where infection has spread beyond ear canal
and in those where topical therapy cannot be delivered effectively. Culture
secretions to guide therapy.
